# The ordinary path, on a target that has the platform's libraries.
CMD|1|hello|1
OBS|ack|1|hello
OBS|hello|1|9d0e1f22|call,resolve,read,reset,report
OBS|part|9d0e1f22|target|console
OBS|part|9d0e1f22|firmware|13.520.001
OBS|part|9d0e1f22|probe|dev
OBS|done|1|ok||
CMD|2|resolve|libkernel|sceKernelGetProcessTime
OBS|ack|2|resolve
OBS|sym|libkernel|sceKernelGetProcessTime|present|shared
OBS|done|2|returned|0x800124a0|
# Called twice, and both results are kept. A clock that returns the same value twice is a
# different finding from one that advances, and neither is visible from a single call.
CMD|3|call|0x800124a0
OBS|ack|3|call
OBS|done|3|returned|0x0000004a3f21c8e0|
CMD|4|call|0x800124a0
OBS|ack|4|call
OBS|done|4|returned|0x0000004a3f2d1140|
CMD|5|bye
OBS|ack|5|bye
OBS|done|5|ok||
